figures.before: Why Occupied Hospital Renovation Is Different From Any Other Project Type
figures.alt: Occupied hospital expansion corridor with sealed ICRA partition, negative-air machine, clean hospital circulation, and organized temporary protection
figures.caption: Occupied healthcare work has to protect care delivery while construction moves forward. Separation, air control, routes, emergency access, utilities, noise, schedule, and daily coordination all become part of the job.

figures.alt: Hospital life-safety coordination area with protected egress route, temporary construction separation, and clearly maintained corridor access
figures.caption: Interim life-safety planning connects the construction area to the building’s operating safeguards: egress, fire protection, detection, emergency response, communication, and the measures used while conditions are temporarily changed.

figures.alt: Healthcare construction containment documentation setup with clean protection materials, inspection checklist, and controlled work-zone entry
figures.caption: Phased hospital work relies on records that make the current condition visible to the people who need it: controls in place, inspections, shutdowns, access routes, work windows, releases, and outstanding issues.
